item.title: Information for Sponsors
item.author: giale@hi.is (NBFC2026)
item.description: The 16th Nordic Baltic Femtochemistry Conference (NBFC) is scheduled to take place from June 29 to July 1, 2026 in Reykjavík, Iceland. The Nordic Baltic Femtochemistry Conference has established itself as a recognized platform for the ultrafast science community, typically attracting around 100 participants from the Nordic and Baltic countries, as well as from elsewhere. NBFC 2026, hosted for the first time at the University of Iceland in Reykjavík, will highlight the latest developments in ultrafast chemistry, physics, and materials science, as well as advancements in optical and X-ray techniques and for experiments with atto- and femtosecond resolution.

item.title: Venue
item.author: giale@hi.is (NBFC2026)
item.description: The 16th Nordic Baltic Femtochemistry Conference will take place in the lecture hall of the Veröld - House of Vigdís bulding at University of Iceland. The address is Brynjólfsgata 1, 107 Reykjavík. HOW TO ARRIVE Keflavík International Airport is located about 55 km or 45 minutes drive from Reykjavík. Airport Direct and Flybus operate transfers from the airport to Reykjavík in connection with all arriving flights. The Flybus runs to the BSÍ bus terminal in Reykjavík, which is located a 15–20 minute walk from the university campus.
